Third-party viewer libraries for the project brochure flipbook (loaded only when a visitor opens one):
- pdf.min.js, pdf.worker.min.js: PDF.js 3.11.174 (pdfjs-dist), Apache License 2.0, https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
- page-flip.browser.js: StPageFlip 2.0.7 (page-flip), MIT License, https://github.com/Nodlik/StPageFlip
